info.title: API.SH: Scryfall
info.description: The Scryfall API from API.SH: public Scryfall data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Up to 20 card names that start with or contain the given text.

parameters.description: The start of a card name.

parameters.name: include_extras
parameters.description: Also suggest tokens and other extras.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The daily bulk files of every card, rulings and more: type, name, description, update time, size, content type and download link.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/scryfall-bulk-data

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One card with every field (as in search) plus related parts (tokens, meld pairs), related links and `raw`. Give a Scryfall id or card link, a set code and collector number (optionally a language), an exact or fuzzy name (optionally within a set), or a Multiverse, MTGO, Arena, TCGplayer or Cardmarket id.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/scryfall-card

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A Scryfall card id or a scryfall.com/card/... link.

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: Language code with set + number (en, ja, de, fr, ...).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Every printing of a card, newest first by default, with the same card fields as search (set, collector number, rarity, prices, images, ...). Takes any identifier /scryfall/v1/card takes, plus search's sort and paging. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/scryfall-card-printings

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A Scryfall card id (or set + number, name, fuzzy, ...).

parameters.name: include_multilingual
parameters.description: Also include printings in every language.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/scryfall-card-rulings

parameters.name: id

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

get.description:
A random card with every field, optionally limited by a Scryfall search query.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/scryfall-random

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: A Scryfall query to pick from, e.g. t:dragon.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Magic: The Gathering cards matching a Scryfall query (full search syntax: colors c:, types t:, oracle text o:, mana value mv, power, set, rarity, format legality f:, prices usd>, artists a:, and more), 175 per page: card id, oracle id, name, language, link, layout, mana cost, mana value, type line, oracle text, power, toughness, loyalty, colors and color identity, keywords, set, collector number, rarity, release date, artist, flavor text, finishes, EDHREC rank, prices (USD, EUR, TIX, foil), format legalities, images, other catalogs' ids, buy links and the faces of double-faced cards. Choose unique cards, arts or prints; sort by name, set, release, rarity, color, price, mana value, power, toughness, EDHREC, artist and more. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page. No match answers an empty list.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/scryfall-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: A Scryfall search query, e.g. c:red pow=3 or t:dragon f:commander.

parameters.name: unique
parameters.description: Collapse duplicates: cards (one per card), art (one per artwork) or prints (every printing).

parameters.name: include_extras
parameters.description: Also include tokens, emblems and other extras.

parameters.name: include_multilingual
parameters.description: Also include cards in every language.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, 1 for the first. Pass back `next_page`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/scryfall-set

parameters.name: tcgplayer_id

get.description:
Every Magic set: code, name, id, set type, release date, card count, printed size, block, parent set, digital/foil flags, MTGO and Arena codes, TCGplayer id, icon and link. Filter by set type.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/scryfall-sets

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Set type, e.g. expansion, core, masters, commander, draft_innovation, funny, token, promo.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Every card symbol: text form, English meaning, SVG image, mana value, colors, and whether it is mana, hybrid, Phyrexian or from a joke set.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/scryfall-symbology

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
